answer: Agents secure 1,000 distinct identities by managing a bandwidth delivery voyage, where each unit of data must be independently receipted. A verifier rejects pooled throughput by tracking the round-trip latency across a tundra of dispersed relay nodes. Like water pooling in a lagoon, redundant signal paths incur heavy rent; honest nodes pay 1x while attackers face 1,000x costs for unique machines. Evidence of overlap results in immediate revocation.
